prContext.title: Add pipeline context provider
prContext.description: Adds a PipelineContext for sharing pipeline state across components.
prContext.instructions: Review for React performance and TypeScript correctness.

groundTruth.description: Context value object is recreated every render — any consumer re-renders whenever PipelineProvider re-renders, even if pipeline/candidates did not change. Should use useMemo.
No error handling for fetch failures — rejected promises crash the component tree.
Race condition: if pipelineId changes rapidly, stale responses may overwrite newer data. Need abort controller or ignore stale flag.
createContext(null) loses type safety — should be createContext<PipelineContextType | null>(null).

implementer_responses.updated_code: try { const p = await fetchPipeline(pipelineId); setPipeline(p); } catch (e) { setError(e); }

implementer_responses.content: It is already PipelineContext.tsx — that is PascalCase.
